title: Fornication with Midian and zeal of Phinehas
english: The reading covers [[Israel’s fornication with Midian and Phinehas’s zeal >> Bible:Numbers 25:1-13]]. The Lord’s wrath is turned; an everlasting priesthood is promised.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Homilia XIX; Peor and census CLOSEOUT.

title: Census voided by sin
english: The former census is voided by sin. Faults so prevail that it does not even help to have been counted among the number.

title: Number written again
english: The people are ordered numbered again. The saints’ number is written [[in the book of life >> Bible:Revelation 20:12]]. Glory to Christ forever. Amen.
